arrivals.generator_mechanism: 200 fixed-count independent uniform releases over 42 days, rounded to minutes; not a Poisson process
arrivals.caution: Gap exponential compatibility is descriptive; fixed count and finite window induce dependence. Rate from clean195 releases would incorrectly treat quality exclusion as lost demand.

selection: Minimum CDF RMSE on chronological final39 versus first156. Selection uses this holdout; not independent final validation.

bootstrap.method: whole-order nonparametric percentile bootstrap; 95% intervals for descriptive mean/P90
bootstrap.limitations: assumes orders iid; does not include structural/service decomposition uncertainty

source_limitation: Demand is assumed normal and independent week to week; lead time normal and independent of demand; one echelon, no MOQ/lot sizes, no capacity limits, no stock-out cost model; ABC classes are assigned by design, not computed. Thresholds are illustrative. Step durations include waiting time. Results describe the synthetic data only and say nothing about any real operation.

dependency.rule: Joint row sampling preserves observed cross-step dependence; independent fitted marginals assume it away. Small empirical correlations do not establish independence.

caveats: Only completion timestamps observed, so elapsed = waiting + processing; resource capacities, utilization, queues and starvation cannot be recovered.
Generator uses independent positive lognormal durations, but source documentation labels them elapsed including waiting; do not reinterpret as observed service.
Workbook data excludes incomplete/negative whole orders; retain all200 releases for demand. Observed timing precision one minute.
Kitting component quantities, processing starts, station resources, shifts, test failures/rework and costs are absent.
Adding a capacity station can only be hypothetical under labelled assumptions; original data cannot validate the causal benefit.
